_comment: Known problems in README.md / data/progress.txt that script/check_readme.py tolerates. One entry per finding — the row's LC number and the exact offending string, never a line number — and each entry excuses exactly one, so the gate fails on anything NOT listed here, a fix shrinks this file, and a known-bad value reappearing on another row fails. Regenerate with `python3 script/check_readme.py --update-baseline`; see the script's docstring.
